Do: Use documented z-* tokens for the application layer
Don't: Rely only on DOM order for stacking

Limit content width for readability
Adjust padding for different screen sizes
Use consistent gap utilities for spacing

Maintain consistent image aspect ratios
Control image scaling within containers

Don't: Use a fixed desktop width at every viewport

Don't: Maintain a legacy content array for ordinary v4 sources

Description: Tailwind v3 made JIT the default; remove obsolete mode configuration during migration
Do: Use the v3 default compiler behavior
Don't: Keep mode:'jit' as a current v4 requirement

Description: Use @apply sparingly
Use maintained plugins only for capabilities not built into core
Don't: Install legacy aspect-ratio or container-query plugins

Description: Define reusable custom utilities with @utility
Use built-in container queries and Tailwind 4.3 container-size queries for component responsiveness
Do: @container with @lg variants and @container-size when both dimensions matter

Description: Style based on parent/sibling state
Use [] for one-off values
Declare color namespaces in @theme so Tailwind generates semantic utilities
Don't: Use arbitrary CSS-variable utilities for registered tokens

Description: Tailwind v4 uses bg-linear-to-* syntax for gradients
Shorter class name for flex-shrink-0
Single utility for equal width and height
Add width and height attributes to reserve intrinsic SVG space before CSS loads
Keep utility class names statically detectable in source
Do: Map variants to complete tokens like colorMap[color]

Description: Polish short multi-line headings without fixing exact line breaks
Do: Use text-balance with a readable max-width and natural wrapping fallback
Don't: Insert hardcoded br tags or blanket nonbreaking spaces

Description: Allow URLs identifiers and user content to break without widening flex layouts
Do: Use wrap-anywhere on unpredictable text and min-w-0 on its flexible parent
Don't: Use break-all globally or keep the flex child at its intrinsic minimum

Description: Handle chip and badge text overflow without breaking compact labels or hiding collection values
Do: Use flex flex-wrap gap-2 for collections; for one label use whitespace-nowrap bounded min-w-0 truncate and shrink-0 controls
Don't: Clip a fixed-height row let labels wrap inside a pill or let dismiss icons shrink
Code Good: flex flex-wrap gap-2; label min-w-0 whitespace-nowrap truncate; icon shrink-0

Guideline: Set the source base path explicitly
Description: Automatic detection starts at the current working directory; a build launched from the monorepo root scans the wrong tree
Do: Pin the base with source("../..") relative to the stylesheet
Don't: Depend on the directory the build happens to start from

Guideline: Use source(none) for an explicit source list
Description: source(none) disables automatic detection; every scanned directory is then declared with @source
Do: List app and shared package directories after source(none)
Don't: Disable detection without registering shared packages

Description: @source not removes paths from scanning and @source inline() generates utilities that never appear in files
Do: Use @source not for generated folders and inline() for runtime classes
Don't: Keep a safelist in a JavaScript config

Description: Theme values that reference runtime variables must be inlined so utilities read the variable at the use site
Don't: Use plain @theme for tokens that point at themed variables

Guideline: Bind dark: to theme classes with @custom-variant
Description: The dark variant follows prefers-color-scheme unless overridden; class-based themes need a custom variant
Do: Declare @custom-variant dark with every dark theme class
Don't: Toggle a dark class that the variant ignores

Description: Unlayered rules beat every layered rule regardless of specificity, so an unlayered :root freezes layered theme tokens
Do: Put :root token defaults and element styles in @layer base
Don't: Write theme tokens on an unlayered :root

Description: Tailwind v4 loads plugins from CSS; no tailwind.config.js is needed
Don't: Keep a JavaScript config only to register a plugin

Guideline: Compile with the Aphrody Bun plugin
Description: @aphrody/bun-plugin-tailwind runs Tailwind v4 on Oxide for Bun.build, Bun.serve HTML imports and the bun ./index.html dev server, with a PostCSS entry for Next.js
Do: Register the plugin in Bun.build, bunfig [serve.static] or postcss.config.mjs
Don't: Run a separate Node-based Tailwind CLI watcher next to Bun

Guideline: Use the (--var) shorthand for raw variables
Description: Tailwind v4 reads an unregistered custom property with parentheses; bracket var() syntax is the v3 form
